verdict.rationale: AngelList's stakeholder dashboard gives investors and other stakeholders a self-serve portal. It shows all of their holdings (convertible notes, shares, transfers) across companies on AngelList, and founders can preview that view. Nothing in the evidence shows founders sending structured investor updates through the platform. The update FAQ also points users toward other cap table providers (J.P. Morgan, Pulley), which raises doubt about whether the product will continue. missing for 10: structured investor update/reporting feature, independent or hands-on confirmation of the investor portal, clarity on product continuity.

support.subject: As a founder, my investors get their own portal view of their holdings and can receive structured updates without emailing me for the cap table

citations.quote: All holdings (convertible notes, shares, transfers, etc) from all of a stakeholder's companies that are on AngelList are available in the dashboard.
From the Stakeholder page select Actions > Preview Dashbaord.
Once logged in, you can accept and acknowledge receipt of the instrument through an e-signature.
